Multicall3.aggregate — Standard stateless multicall utility; no funds held, no value forwarded, arbitrary calls are the intended feature with zero impact.

Multicall3.aggregate3 — Same pattern; requireSuccess flag per call, no value forwarding, zero contract balance.
Multicall3.aggregate3Value — Forwards only caller-provided msg.value (valAccumulator), cannot spend contract's own ETH; utility contract with no stored funds.
MlpToken.mint — Strict role gate: only liquidityPool (immutable/trusted) can mint; no arbitrary caller control.
MlpToken.burn — Strict role gate: only liquidityPool can burn; standard LP token pattern.
